request_evidence.active_span_text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

reference.observable_appearance_only: a visibly adult woman with long dark brown-to-black wavy hair parted near the center, brown eyes, an oval face, natural makeup, and a neutral expression

randomization.selector_method: Interpret the first entropy byte as an unsigned integer and take modulo 6.

selected_complex_scenario: nighttime emergency freshwater allocation inside a storm-struck coastal desalination plant

subject_event_precommit.subject: one visibly adult woman based only on the reference's observable appearance

subject_event_precommit.resource: potable freshwater routed from the desalination plant to three marked community tanks
subject_event_precommit.single_frame_causality: handover token, active control, predecessor withdrawal, crew deference, and changed water routing must coexist legibly in one photograph

the outgoing controller places the brass master key and a signed emergency authorization folio into her hands
she turns the brass master key in the console's COMMAND socket
the outgoing controller steps behind a red authority line
